item.title: Support U.S. assistance of Ukraine in fight against Russia
item.description: HeraldNet.com HeraldNet.com - Everett and Snohomish County news from The Daily Herald in Everett, Washington As we enter the fourth year of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, we must remember that Ukraine’s future still matters. How this war ends matters. If Russia is rewarded for its aggression, the fighting will only pause until Moscow has time to rearm and strike again.
